scope: A bounded exploratory literature search for chaos in two specific published models; not a systematic review or a proof of novelty.
additional_checks: OpenAlex forward-citation query for each DOI, with returned identities saved in citation_search.json
Abstract/title screening of returned citing works; no exact-model chaos report identified
Primary publisher record confirms existing classical inertial-neuron chaos: doi:10.1016/j.chaos.2020.110383
Primary publisher records confirm existing chaos in other meminductor emulators: doi:10.1016/j.vlsi.2024.102165 and doi:10.1016/j.vlsi.2026.102740

The quantum-neuron preprint contains chaos-related bibliography entries, but its model results describe periodic oscillations; those references were not mistaken for a chaos demonstration in the quantum model
access_limits: The publisher quantum article was available through indexed text; direct HTTP fetches were blocked. Numerical implementation uses the explicit accessible arXiv v1 equations.
Some publisher redirects failed; the meminductor primary full text was obtained as Europe PMC XML.
No exhaustive search of subscription citation indexes, all dissertations, unindexed work, or equivalent equations under other names was completed.
conclusion: No matching strange-attractor report was identified for the two exact targets. Broad classes are already known to exhibit chaos. Publication novelty is unverified.
